title: Experts Provide Tips for Avoiding Computer-linked Vision Trouble
titleZh: 专家提供避免电脑相关视力问题的建议
credits: Cathy Bussewitz reported on this story for the Associated Press. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Computer, or digital, screens are common at work, homes, schools, and stores.
sentences.zh: 电脑或数字屏幕在工作场所、家庭、学校和商店中都很普遍。

sentences.en: An estimated 104 million Americans of working age spend more than seven hours a day in front of screens, the American Optometric Association says.
sentences.zh: 美国验光协会称，估计有1.04亿适龄美国人在屏幕前每天花费的时间超过七小时。

sentences.en: All that screen time can cause harm.
sentences.zh: 长时间的屏幕使用可能会造成伤害。

sentences.en: Too much screen viewing can lead to dry or watery eyes, unclear vision and headaches.
sentences.zh: 过多的屏幕观看可能导致眼睛干涩或流泪、视力模糊和头痛。

sentences.en: It can also lead to vision conditions including myopia, or nearsightedness, especially in children.
sentences.zh: 它还可能导致包括近视在内的视力问题，尤其是在儿童中。

sentences.en: Some technology workers even describe short times of dizziness or vertigo when they look at screens for too long.
sentences.zh: 一些科技工作者甚至描述说，当他们看屏幕时间过长时，会出现短暂的头晕或眩晕。

sentences.en: However, exposure to blue light from digital screens has not been shown to cause permanent eye damage, the American Academy of Ophthalmology says.
sentences.zh: 然而，美国眼科协会表示，尚未有证据表明数字屏幕发出的蓝光会造成永久性眼睛损伤。

sentences.en: One reason for the screen-linked vision problems lies in the eye muscles.
sentences.zh: 与屏幕相关的视力问题之一的原因在于眼部肌肉。

sentences.en: Staring closely at screens for long amounts of time can cause the muscle used for eye focus to become too tense, or tight.
sentences.zh: 长时间近距离盯着屏幕会导致用于聚焦眼睛的肌肉变得过于紧张或紧绷。

sentences.en: “That muscle's not supposed to stay tight all day long.
sentences.zh: “这块肌肉本不该一整天都保持紧绷。

sentences.en: And if it does, it's like picking up a light weight and trying to hold it over your head for hours,” American Optometric Association President Steven Reed told the Associated Press (AP).
sentences.zh: 如果它真的这样，就像举起一个轻重量物体并试图几个小时都举在头顶上方，”美国验光协会主席史蒂文·里德向美联社（AP）表示。

sentences.en: It is not hard to lift, he said, “But after a while, even though it’s not a heavy lift, your body just gets tired,” he added.
sentences.zh: 他说，举起它并不难，‘但过一会儿，即使不是重活，你的身体也会感到疲惫，’他补充道。

sentences.en: The vision problems can affect work, family time and rest.
sentences.zh: 这些问题可能会影响到工作、家庭时间和休息。

sentences.en: As an optometrist in Mississippi, Reed sees people who are experiencing eye pain, headaches and unclear vision linked with computer use.
sentences.zh: 作为密西西比州的一名验光师，里德看到了因使用电脑而经历眼部疼痛、头痛和视力模糊的人。

sentences.en: He suggests that people with such problems get an eye examination and take regular breaks from screen viewing.
sentences.zh: 他建议有此类问题的人进行眼科检查，并定期从屏幕前休息。

sentences.en: Here are some more tips from eye health professionals to reduce eye strain caused by devices.
sentences.zh: 以下是眼科健康专家的一些更多建议，以减少因设备引起的眼睛疲劳。

sentences.en: Take a break every 20 minutes from looking at a computer.
sentences.zh: 每20分钟从看电脑中休息一下。

sentences.en: During the break, focus your eyes on something that is about 20 feet away (6 meters) for 20 seconds.
sentences.zh: 在休息期间，将眼睛聚焦在约20英尺（6米）远的某物上20秒钟。

sentences.en: This will help ease tired, tight eye muscles.
sentences.zh: 这将有助于缓解疲劳和紧绷的眼部肌肉。

sentences.en: “Luckily, eye strain is temporary,” said Raj Maturi, an eye doctor, or ophthalmologist, at Midwest Eye Institute in Indianapolis and spokesperson for the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
sentences.zh: ‘幸运的是，眼睛疲劳是暂时的，’印第安纳波利斯的中西部眼科研究所眼科医生、美国眼科协会发言人拉吉·马图里说道。

sentences.en: “The best way to avoid these symptoms is by taking breaks from our screens or near work activities and using lubricating eye drops, if needed,” he said.
sentences.zh: "避免这些症状的最佳方法是经常离开屏幕或近距离工作，并在需要时使用润滑眼药水，"他说。

sentences.en: People normally close their eyes very briefly about 18 to 22 times per minute.
sentences.zh: 人们通常每分钟会眨眼18到22次，每次时间非常短暂。

sentences.en: This helps lubricate the eye naturally.
sentences.zh: 这有助于自然地润滑眼睛。

sentences.en: But when looking at a screen, people might close their eyes only three to seven times per minute, the Cleveland Clinic says.
sentences.zh: 但克利夫兰诊所表示，当盯着屏幕看时，人们每分钟可能只眨眼三到七次。

sentences.en: That is when use of eye drops might be considered.
sentences.zh: 这时就可能考虑使用眼药水。

sentences.en: Some people find that using a larger computer screen helps reduce eye tiredness, or fatigue.
sentences.zh: 有些人发现使用更大的电脑屏幕有助于缓解眼睛疲劳。

sentences.en: You can also increase the image size on your laptop, monitor or smartphone screen.
sentences.zh: 你也可以增大笔记本电脑、显示器或智能手机屏幕上的图像尺寸。

sentences.en: Sitting an arm’s length away from your screen and looking down at it also can help reduce eye strain, the American Academy of Ophthalmology says.
sentences.zh: 美国眼科协会表示，与屏幕保持一臂的距离并略微向下看也有助于缓解眼睛疲劳。

sentences.en: Some products for computer users, such as blue light glasses, are marketed with claims that they will reduce eye strain, improve sleep and prevent eye disease.
sentences.zh: 一些面向电脑用户的产品，如防蓝光眼镜，被宣传称能够缓解眼睛疲劳、改善睡眠并预防眼疾。

sentences.en: But several studies have found the glasses are not very effective, says the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
sentences.zh: 但美国眼科协会表示，多项研究已发现这类眼镜的效果并不显著。

sentences.en: The group says it is how people use digital devices that causes problems, not the blue light coming from screens.
sentences.zh: 该协会表示，问题出在人们使用数字设备的方式上，而不是屏幕发出的蓝光。

sentences.en: Even after stepping away from work on larger computers, many adults find themselves using smaller digital devices for reading or watching shows.
sentences.zh: 即使在较大的电脑上结束工作后，许多成年人发现自己仍在使用较小的数字设备进行阅读或观看节目。

sentences.en: And many children use small digital devices such as laptops, tablets, and smartphones in school.
sentences.zh: 许多儿童在学校里也会使用笔记本电脑、平板电脑和智能手机等小型数字设备。

sentences.en: Ayesha Malik of the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia said that too much screen time or focusing on nearby objects can speed development of nearsightedness, especially in children.
sentences.zh: 费城儿童医院的爱莎·马利克表示，过多的屏幕时间或长时间聚焦于近处物体可能加速近视的发展，尤其在儿童中更为明显。

sentences.en: She added that anyone watching shows should do so on a television, instead of a tablet, to help avoid eye strain.
sentences.zh: 她还表示，任何人观看节目都应使用电视而非平板电脑，以帮助缓解眼睛疲劳。

sentences.en: Children should follow the 20-20-20-2 rule, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，儿童应遵循20-20-20-2法则。

sentences.en: The added “2” stands for 2 hours of play outside every day, which helps with eye development, Malik said.
sentences.zh: 马利克表示，额外增加的“2”代表每天在户外玩耍2小时，这有助于眼睛发育。

sentences.en: “The reality is that most children are engaging with screens throughout the day at school and home.
sentences.zh: "现实情况是，大多数儿童在学校和家中整天都在接触屏幕。

sentences.en: It becomes difficult to track the total number of hours,” she said.
sentences.zh: 很难追踪总时长，"她说。

sentences.en: “Aim for not more than 20 minutes during any one session.”
sentences.zh: "目标是任何一次使用屏幕的时间不要超过20分钟。"

sentences.en: The blue light that digital screens release can increase a person’s alertness, experts say.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，数字屏幕发出的蓝光会增加人的警觉性。

sentences.en: As a result, their use might make it difficult to fall asleep or sleep well.
sentences.zh: 因此，使用这些设备可能会让人难以入睡或睡不好。

sentences.en: To give your eyes and brain the rest they need, doctors suggest turning off screens one to two hours before going to sleep.
sentences.zh: 为了让眼睛和大脑得到所需的休息，医生建议在上睡前一到两个小时关闭屏幕。

sentences.en: You can also change the setting on digital devices to lower screen brightness.
sentences.zh: 你也可以调整数字设备的设置，降低屏幕亮度。

sentences.en: If you are used to watching videos at night, try listening to an audiobook or podcast instead.
sentences.zh: 如果你习惯在晚上看视频，不妨尝试听有声读物或播客。

sentences.en: And I'm John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。

a health care professional who examines and treats the eye for problems
to give attention to something, to participate
to apply something that lessens or prevents difficulty or friction
tiredness or exhaustion from exertion or stress
the action or process of developing (or progressing)
